title: thelypteris subnigra
intro: Thelypteris subnigra, commonly known as the black maidenhair fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris subnigra include reducing inflammation, relieving coughs, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris subnigra include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
